integrity.claim_basis: analytic character-orthogonality proof with an independent finite exact enumeration as corroboration
integrity.computational_scope: exact enumeration for 2 <= n <= 40; not used as an infinite proof

scientific_limitations: The theorem assumes independent Haar-uniform coefficient phases and does not cover finite alphabets, periodic correlations, or dependent ensembles.
The result gives the exact variance but does not establish a central limit theorem or tail estimate.
An older equivalent finite-variance identity under different random-sequence notation remains a residual literature risk.
title: Exact finite variance of the fourth moment of a random unimodular polynomial
